================================================================================
The example of usql
================================================================================

select 1 as n, 'two' as s from t where a = _v;

---

(source_file
  (select_statement
    (select
      (aliased_expression
        (number)
        (identifier))

        (string)
        (identifier))

        (table_reference

            (identifier))))

          (column_reference
            (identifier))
          (operator)
          (column_reference
            (identifier)))))))
